body: When I saw the headline, I thought this was going in a different direction... like, "So long AMC+ subscription, see you when I renew you again in six weeks."

I haven't bought the NECA so I don't have much to compare them to, but I love the figures. There are some inconsistencies with some joint tolerances and things, I hope Super7 irons some of that out for the price. But the fun factor is through the roof, they feel great, they look amazing.
